modmenu.name: Curse-Cycle
modmenu.description: Random survival challenges with a configurable schedule.
text.cursecycle.menu.title: Curse-Cycle menu
text.cursecycle.menu.home.about: Curse-Cycle adds random challenges to survival. The wheel selects a restriction, such as no sprinting, no jumping or no armor.
text.cursecycle.menu.home.rules: A new world starts with preparation, followed by the first wheel. Its challenge begins after the animation. Later wheels announce the next challenge in advance; the current one continues until the scheduled change. Previous restrictions end when the challenge changes. A double challenge applies two rules together.
text.cursecycle.menu.home.timing: Server schedule: %s seconds of preparation; a change every %s in-game days; announced %s in-game days early.
text.cursecycle.menu.home.use: Current menu key: %s. Rebind it in Minecraft → Options → Controls → Key Binds → Curse-Cycle. In Active, click a challenge to read its detailed rules. Next shows the wheel result; History lists past challenges.
text.cursecycle.menu.home.settings: Settings controls the schedule, HUD and wheel animation. Normal gameplay does not require commands; the Commands tab lists them. Esc closes this window.
text.cursecycle.menu.commands.list: /fdc list — all challenges and their IDs.
text.cursecycle.menu.commands.permission: These commands require cheats in singleplayer or operator level 2 on a server. They affect the shared game.
text.cursecycle.menu.commands.trigger_sp: /fdc trigger_spin — select the next challenge and spin the wheel. During initial preparation, skips the wait; the challenge starts after the wheel.
text.cursecycle.menu.commands.activate_n: /fdc activate_next — start the wheel result immediately and restart the countdown.
text.cursecycle.menu.commands.activate: /fdc activate <id> — replace current challenges with this one. Tab suggests available IDs.
text.cursecycle.menu.commands.setday: /fdc setday <day> — change the world day. May trigger a scheduled challenge change.
text.cursecycle.menu.commands.reset: /fdc reset — remove challenges, clear history and restart preparation. Resets world time to day 1.
text.cursecycle.menu.setting.scope: Shared by all players. Saved in this installation's config.
text.cursecycle.menu.setting.readonly: Only the singleplayer owner or a server operator (level 2) can edit this schedule. You can view it.
text.cursecycle.menu.setting.unavailable: This server does not support schedule editing. Update the server mod.
text.cursecycle.menu.setting.validation: Interval ≥ 1; notice from 0 to interval; preparation ≥ 0. One game day is 24,000 ticks; sleeping advances the regular cycle.
text.cursecycle.menu.setting.applies: Apply saves the schedule. A changed interval starts counting from now. Changing preparation restarts its countdown if the first wheel has not begun. Current challenges continue.
text.cursecycle.menu.setting.failed: Could not save the config. See latest.log for details.
text.cursecycle.menu.setting.timeout: No server response. Check the connection and try again.
text.cursecycle.menu.debug.title: Cycle debugging
text.cursecycle.menu.debug.description: Emergency actions for testing and recovering the challenge cycle.
text.cursecycle.menu.debug.permissions: Buttons require cheats in singleplayer or operator level 2. Actions affect the shared world.
text.cursecycle.menu.debug.trigger_spin_: Selects the next challenge and shows the wheel. The current challenge remains until the new one is activated.
text.cursecycle.menu.debug.activate_next: Immediately activates the saved wheel result and starts a new countdown.
text.cursecycle.menu.debug.reset_help: Dangerous: removes challenges, clears history and returns preparation to day one.
